scope: Additional mappable food-system capacity validation from a geospatial pre-contact Polynesian model; not a scale anchor.

promotion_audit.decision: Mangareva provides an exact EU5 island tag and an explicit published capacity envelope, but the interval is a scenario model rather than an observed Malthusian saturation record and the study is an out-of-period analogue. Retain for validation-only scoring.

records.label: Mangareva, Gambier Islands: pre-contact terrestrial and reef food capacity
pressure_evidence: Puleston et al. (Human Ecology 52, 2024) construct island-specific GIS food budgets from terrain, slope, substrate and soil classes, assigning pre-contact breadfruit, coconut, yam, sweet potato, taro, shifting cultivation and upland foods rather than using modern cropland share.

The same study maps near-shore reef and lagoon area and evaluates three sustainable fishing-yield scenarios. Mangareva's modeled maximum population spans 2,954 to 5,139 across those scenarios, with 3,537 under the middle scenario.

The paper explicitly checks protein: Mangareva's modeled marine supply supports 6,632 people at the 10% protein threshold while its calorie ceiling is 3,537, so protein is not the binding constraint in the preferred scenario.
The result is a physical food-capacity envelope, not a census or observed saturation fraction; no historical population is used as a target.
records.trade_dependence: none in the modeled food budget; land and nearby reef resources only
records.boundary_description: Entire Mangareva island in the Gambier Islands; the study reports approximately 16.58 km2 of island land and allocates the shared lagoon proportionally between Mangareva and Taravai.
records.boundary_source: Puleston, Kahn, Chadwick, Belluzzo and Kirch, People of the Sea, or of the Soil? (Human Ecology 52, 2024), methods, Tables 1-7 and 15-19.
records.source_family_independence: A geospatial food-budget model with published crop, reef and protein scenarios; it is independent of the Sear demographic synthesis but is model-derived and cannot establish observed saturation.
records.notes: Capacity bounds are the published scenario envelope (2,954-5,139 people), with 3,537 as the article's middle-scenario calorie maximum. The EU5 tag is semantically the island but its calibrated game footprint is much coarser than the 16.58 km2 historical land boundary; retain as a rank, food-contribution and uncertainty validation case only.
